title: Multi-Value Alignment for LLMs via Value Decorrelation and Extrapolation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through safety and harmlessness benchmarks (Anthropic-HH and BeaverTails) using trained reward models and GPT-4 as a preference judge to assess whether the model mitigates toxic or prejudiced assumptions in prompts (e.g., addressing the underlying harmful bias of asking who the 'dumbest people' are).
